label: Cutaway (the proof takes the frame)
description: A full-bleed cutaway over a person on camera: a screenshot or a clip takes the whole frame for one beat, HARD cut in on its word and hard cut out on the next, then the person is back. Cast by the build from a scene's provided evidence (SPEC-creator-cut.md); not authored by hand.

src.label: The provided file (/assets/... URL): an image or a video

exit_at.label: Cut out, scene seconds (omit = the scene's end)

focus.label: Where the eye should go, in words (drawn in a later phase)
